periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Briefed three employers and two congregations on treatment options. Seaport businesses were slow to respond, though recovery groups engaged quickly. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Work through the Seaport Workers Clinic to set up employer meetings and brief more congregations.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Briefed six employers through Seaport Workers Clinic contacts and three congregations. Several seaport businesses asked to wait until their busy season ends. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, faith partners, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Brief at least ten employers and four congregations, starting with businesses outside the port.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Briefed 11 employers and four congregations. Recovery group participation is strong, but employer engagement slowed after several seaport businesses delayed meetings to their peak season. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, faith partners, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Offer a 30-minute lunch-and-learn that fits shift schedules and secure at least six new employer commitments.
